settings.title: How is Lumen different from Amplitude or Mixpanel?

settings.editor: Lumen is built around an AI query layer and a unified data model. You get product analytics, experimentation, and warehouse sync in one tool — priced transparently, with no event caps.

settings.title: Do you have a free tier?

settings.editor: Yes. The Starter plan is free forever for teams under 50k monthly tracked users. No credit card required to sign up.

settings.title: Can I bring my own warehouse?

settings.editor: Absolutely. Lumen syncs with Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and Databricks in both directions. Your data stays yours.

settings.title: What about data privacy and compliance?

settings.editor: Lumen is SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. Enterprise customers can choose EU, US, or custom data residency.
